sources.scope: Only the four selected rules sections listed by source keys in config/identities.json; not blanket clearance of the wiki.
sources.review: Wiki declares applicable non-Product-Identity rules Open Game Content. These selected feat, gear and base-class rules contain no copied artwork, maps, named setting characters or setting narrative. Preserve the complete published OGL text and copyright-notice list. Incanter and Extra Magic Talent use the Ultimate tab; equipment uses its current rules section. Other collections remain unreviewed. Favorite Tools uses the current Artifice skill-talent section from Spheres of Guile. The retained notice list includes Spheres of Guile (2023).

sources.scope: Only four contained records registered in config/containers.json. Rules from Adventurer’s Armory, Ultimate Equipment, Animal Archive and Core Rulebook. Not artwork or software.
sources.review: Selected mundane equipment rules and native rules data are Open Game Content. Preserve PF1 Content OGL notices together with wiki notices (including Animal Archive). Retain upstream GPL notice for record-format contributions, and ship the human-reviewable adapted kit JSON as corresponding source. No upstream program code or image bytes copied.

sources.scope: Only rule sections and entity kinds from the exact page snapshots in config/intake-sources.json. Excludes artwork, navigation, ads, non-target narrative and unreviewed page changes.
sources.review: Selected feats, base-class mechanics/class features, Guile talent rules and price/weight-bearing equipment sections are game rules covered by the wiki OGL declaration. Preserve full wiki OGL notices and exact source URLs/hashes; native content-source labels name the wiki without fabricated book or publisher details. Descriptive draft and mechanics review are separate from this rights scope.

sources.scope: Only Adventurers Sash, Filter Scarf, Parasol Umbrella and Whiskey (Cup) adaptations registered in config/physical-item-reviews.json; rules and native record data, not upstream artwork or program code.

Retain GPL-3.0 for upstream record-format contributions and ship adapted physical JSON in sources/items. Core scarf and goblet images are referenced only; sash and umbrella images are original generated art.

sources.scope: Reviewed PF1 11.11 Longsword, Trail Rations, Blunderbuss, Pistol, Musket, Sling Bullet, Firearm Bullet, Light Mace, Greatsword and Sack native data adapted in config/physical-item-reviews.json.
